Author: Pankaj Bhatia

High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:239629
Court No. - 66
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 43888 of 2023
Applicant :- Yunus
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Ajay Kumar Srivastava

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
No one appears for the respondent no.4 despite notice.

2. The accused-applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No.322 of 2022 under sections 452, 354, 323,
504, 506, 376 Ka, Kha IPC and section 5-M/6 POCSO Act, P.S. Baraut, District Baghpat.

3. The FIR in question was lodged after about seven days alleging that on 15.04.2022, the applicant was found with the daughter of the informant lying on the same bed and when the informant came,
the applicant fled away from the spot.

In the statement under section 161 Cr.P.C., no allegation of commission of offence under section 376 IPC was made, even before the medical authorities, no allegation of the offence under section 376 IPC were made.

Subsequently, in the statement under Yunus vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/12830762/
1 section 164 Cr.P.C., the allegation of the commission of the offence under section 376 IPC were made, however they are not corroborated with the medical on record.

entities.text: Yunus vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. The submission of the counsel for the applicant is that the FIR was lodged as a sequence to an FIR lodged at the instance of the applicant against the family members of the informant vide case crime no.304 of 2022.
The applicant is in custody since 17.05.2022 and has no criminal history.

5. Considering the huge variance in the statements, the inordinate delay in lodging the FIR and prima-facie convinced that the FIR was a sequence to the FIR lodged by the applicant against the family members of the informant coupled with the fact that the applicant is in custody since 17.05.2022 and has no criminal history, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
Thus the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Yunus be released on bail in aforesaid first information report number subject to his furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties of Rs.25000/- (Twenty Five Thousand)
each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 18.12.2023 VNP/-
